check_pypi_for_latest_release: check PyPI for the latest release version of a given library name
get_github_release_info: fetch the latest release tag, URL, and publish time from a GitHub repository
notify_slack: send a formatted release notification message to a Slack channel via webhook
run_release_notification: run the main workflow to check PyPI and GitHub versions and notify Slack on new releases
refactor_notify_slack: refactor the notify_slack function to support custom message templates or additional channels
